description: Boundary and logical-path coverage for signal-triggered shutdown: a signal with no registered workers (only the signal line is emitted), and alternate term-signal labels (SIGINT, SIGQUIT) over a leaf subset and a single root worker, confirming the reported signal label is echoed from the input and always precedes the dependency-ordered node lines.

cases.expected_output:
signal=SIGINT
node=AsyncFuse marker=1
node=Rpc marker=2
